about: The author's verdicts on whole clips, the ground truth gates/continuity_gate.py is held to by --validate. A FAIL case names the
axis the break is on, props or background, and the window in seconds where the author saw it, and the gate agrees only with a
break named on that axis inside that window. A null window is the whole clip, for a break he named by what moved rather than
when. A case with a board and a spot is judged with that spot's scene lines beside it, and a span keeps a master's story apart
from its closer. A presenter case is measured by the ruler, not judged. sha256 is the file that was labelled, so a take replaced
in place is never judged under its old verdict. The masters and takes are media and stay out of git, and ADS8_TAKES names the
directory holding the ads8-real closer takes. Eight cases is a thin set: three judged on two masters, five measured.
